capabilityHints.summary: A creator launches one fixed-supply token against WETH; traders pay a fee chosen by whoever pays the most per block for the right to choose it, and the providers behind that pool receive the rent.

components.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical PoolKey. It admits exactly one pool once, returns the auctioned LP fee as a beforeSwap override, charges the hook-owned volume fee on executed gross quote-side amounts across all four quadrants, runs the permissionless rent auction and donates accrued rent to in-range positions.

Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical pool, seeds one full-range position and settles both currencies; any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.
Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists.

project.summary: Sell the right to set one canonical launch pool's LP fee on a continuous permissionless rent auction and pay that rent back to the same pool's providers every swap.
project.title: PoolRent
